title: GraphSmith side-effect receipt (R2)
description: The external system's returned confirmation for one recorded effect, captured where the adapter provides one; an UNKNOWN status where it does not. Extends the E (effect-reconciled) profile. Honest boundary: this is once-and-replay-verified reconciliation of a RECORDED effect — NOT exactly-once end-to-end (true single-delivery still needs an idempotency key the external system honours). C1-binding: `ts` is evidence, recorded, never a decision input. Frozen Wave 0 (v0.4.0).

adapter_id.description: The adapter namespace that produced this receipt.

external_id.description: The external system's returned id for the effect (present iff the adapter provides one). Its presence is what upgrades an effect from UNKNOWN to reconciled.

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key sent to the external system, if any. End-to-end single delivery depends on the external system honouring this key — an adapter-author property, not something GSA verifies.

status.description: success = external system confirmed; unknown = no receipt from the adapter (UNKNOWN_EFFECT path — reconciliation-required, fail-closed); failed = external system rejected.

ts.description: Timestamp of the receipt. EVIDENCE ONLY (C1) — never a decision input. Optional; absence is not a failure.
